newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bradesco Seguros H1 net higher - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bradesco Seguros H1 net higher - paper.

text.p: Brazilian insurer Bradesco Seguros posted a 202.7 million-real net profit for the first half, up 52.19 percent from the same period last year, a local newspaper said.
The increase was mainly due to earnings on capitalization transactions and private pension funds controlled by the group, Gazeta Mercantil said.

The firm also boosted return on equity to 14.71 percent in the first half from 11.88 percent and its net worth rose to 1.373 billion reais in the period versus 1.1 billion reais in 1995's first six months, it said.
